Package edu.secourse.view

Class AppointmentView

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.view.AppointmentView
public class AppointmentView extends Object
Console-based view class responsible for handling all appointment interactions.

This class provides methods for:

  • Displaying menus and prompts to the user
  • Collecting appointment input from the console
  • Displaying appointment information and system messages

The AppointmentView is part of the presentation layer in the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture. It does not contain business logic, but instead delegates processing to the controller.
